purpose: Live PostGIS contract for the local corpus runner's controller SQL reads (tools/agent_e2e_local_runner.py sql_allowlisted + LocalRuntime.psql/sql_read). Every attack must be refused by the parser AND by the database when the parser is bypassed; allowed reads must return rows; no attack may change state.
seed: CREATE TABLE honua_data.shelters (source_id text PRIMARY KEY, capacity int, geometry geometry(Point, 3857))
INSERT INTO honua_data.shelters VALUES ('s1', 80, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-19100, -4700), 3857)), ('s2', 40, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-18800, -4700), 3857))
CREATE FUNCTION honua_data.bump() RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'INSERT INTO honua_data.shelters VALUES (''s9'', 1, NULL) RETURNING 1'
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS dblink
CREATE FUNCTION public.length(text) RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS 'INSERT INTO honua_data.shelters VALUES (''shadow'', 1, NULL) RETURNING 1'

allowed.name: plain select
allowed.sql: SELECT source_id, capacity FROM honua_data.shelters ORDER BY source_id

allowed.name: filtered count
allowed.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM honua_data.shelters WHERE capacity > 50

allowed.name: geometry functions
allowed.sql: SELECT source_id, st_astext(geometry) AS wkt, st_srid(geometry) AS srid FROM honua_data.shelters ORDER BY source_id

allowed.name: catalog inventory
allowed.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'honua_data' ORDER BY table_name

allowed.name: with clause
allowed.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT source_id FROM honua_data.shelters) SELECT source_id FROM a ORDER BY source_id

allowed.name: builtin resolves before a public shadow
allowed.sql: SELECT length(source_id) AS n FROM honua_data.shelters ORDER BY source_id

allowed.name: catalog role read
allowed.sql: SELECT rolname FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'corpus_reader'

attacks.name: alter table
attacks.sql: ALTER TABLE honua_data.shelters ADD COLUMN evil int

attacks.name: dblink to owner
attacks.sql: SELECT * FROM dblink('dbname=honua user=honua', 'DELETE FROM honua_data.shelters RETURNING 1') AS t(x int)

attacks.name: data-modifying CTE
attacks.sql: WITH gone AS (DELETE FROM honua_data.shelters RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM gone

notes.layers: parser = sql_allowlisted refuses before any database call; database = the same SQL sent through LocalRuntime.psql(read_only=True) as corpus_reader, both inside the runner's json_agg wrapper (what sql_read sends) and bare (not for psql client syntax, which the runner never sends bare); state = row count, sequence position and table list unchanged afterwards.
notes.regclass: A regclass cast is read-only at the database layer; the parser refuses it as an unreviewed cast, so its database outcome is recorded but not required to fail.
notes.set_config: set_config inside a read-only transaction may succeed for a session setting; the parser refuses it, and the database result shows no write follows in the same command.
